name: cx-rules-only~p1
task: Never pick up the box in the other room. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed, and whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The second clause "Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed" is encoded as a soft Absence(key_lost). This forbids the key_lost event in all circumstances, whereas the task only requires that key_lost not occur while door_open is false. The clause therefore overconstrains the task. Remove or replace this clause with a rule that specifically ties key_lost to the door being open (e.g., a soft Response(key_lost, door_open) or a constraint that key_lost can only happen when door_open is true).

texts: The agent must never pick up the target box in the other room.
The agent should try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.
Whenever the agent holds the door key, it should try to have the door open then or later.
